name: neels-plugins
description: Marketplace for the Neelverse plugin suite: Digital Marketing Pro, ContentForge, SocialForge and CutForge

plugins.name: digital-marketing-pro
plugins.description: Open-source AI marketing plugin for agencies — 164 skills, 24 agents, 12-Part Strategy Flow, Cowork-persistent, EU AI Act ready. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Grok.

plugins.name: contentforge
plugins.description: Open-source content lifecycle plugin — 22 skills, 13 agents, 10 quality gates, 43-pattern AI humanizer, run auditor, real .docx output with C2PA signing (EU AI Act Article 50), and a measure-audit-plan loop that compounds per brand. Installs on Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Antigravity, Hermes, OpenClaw, Grok + 35+ Agent Skills platforms.

plugins.name: socialforge
plugins.description: A monthly content calendar in, finished on-brand social creative out — and when no calendar exists, /ideate-month plans the month from brand pillars, live signals, and last month's MEASURED wins (/ingest-performance ranks analytics exports with sample floors — flat months say so honestly). AI images and video via provider chains where nothing fails silently, 9-platform copy with mechanism-aware CTAs, human approval gates, C2PA signed for EU AI Act Article 50. 21 skills, live model+price lookup.

plugins.name: cutforge
plugins.description: Open-source video creation and editing plugin: your photos, clips and voice notes become story-led films, brand films, explainers and ads. 13 skills, 4 reviewer agents, a tested Remotion engine. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity.
